description: Code-behind file for the 'StartExam' page in an online examination system. Handles user session validation, course selection based on semester, initiating theory or MCQ exams, and checking if student has already taken an exam.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the 'StartExam' page, managing exam selection and initiation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; validates session and populates course dropdown based on semester.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates the selected exam (Theory or MCQ) after checking questions availability.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam from GridView; checks if student already taken and starts exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam from GridView; checks if student already taken and starts exam.
